reading.title: An evening with friends
reading.text: Mona invites her best friend Dina to dinner. They have known each other for years. Sami is an acquaintance she has met only twice. Her classmate Noor brings a salad, and her colleague Karim arrives after work. Layla is her neighbor and lives next door. Omar brings his roommate Tarek. They share a flat. Hana arrives with Rami, her spouse. Mona introduces everyone so the guests understand how they know each other. Omar calls Luis his pen pal because they exchange letters. Tarek is a companion on Omar’s walks. Hana is Rami’s wife and partner in marriage.
